methods.name: set_function_expression_property
methods.docstring:
X.set_function_expression_property(function_path, expression_id, property_name, property_value) -> bool
Set a property on an expression inside a Material Function's graph.
Maps to action="set_function_expression_property"

Like SetExpressionProperty but operates on a UMaterialFunction.

Args:
    function_path (str): Full asset path to the UMaterialFunction
    expression_id (str): Expression ID
    property_name (str): Property name
    property_value (str): Value as string

Returns:
    bool: True if successful

methods.name: set_expression_property
methods.docstring:
X.set_expression_property(material_path, expression_id, property_name, property_value) -> bool
Set a property value on an expression.
Maps to action="set_property"

Args:
    material_path (str): Full path to the material
    expression_id (str): ID of expression

Returns:

methods.name: create_custom_expression
methods.signature: (material_path, code, output_type="CMOT_Float3", description="Custom", input_names="", pos_x=0, pos_y=0) -> MaterialExpressionInfo
methods.docstring:
X.create_custom_expression(material_path, code, output_type="CMOT_Float3", description="Custom", input_names="", pos_x=0, pos_y=0) -> MaterialExpressionInfo
Create a Custom HLSL expression node with code, output type, and optional inputs.
Maps to action="create_custom_expression"

Args:
    material_path (str): Full path to the material
    code (str): HLSL code string (e.g., "return Input0 * 2.0;")
    output_type (str): Output type: "CMOT_Float1", "CMOT_Float2", "CMOT_Float3", "CMOT_Float4", "CMOT_MaterialAttributes"
    description (str): Display name for the node
    input_names (str): Comma-separated custom input names (e.g., "Albedo,Mask,UV") or empty for no custom inputs
    pos_x (int32): X position in graph
    pos_y (int32): Y position in graph

Returns:
    MaterialExpressionInfo: Created expression info Example: node = unreal.MaterialNodeService.create_custom_expression("/Game/M_Test", "return Input0 * 2;", "CMOT_Float3", "DoubleIt", "Color", -500, 0)
